name: Marketing & Content
description: A results-first home page with headline campaign figures, writing samples and campaign case studies for marketers and content writers.
guidance: Only publish figures and client names you are allowed to share. Check your client and employer agreements, round or index confidential numbers, and ask permission before naming a client or showing unreleased campaigns.

heroSuggestions.title: Marketing and Content Strategist
heroSuggestions.summary: Marketing and content strategist who turns audience insight into campaigns and writing that grow reach and revenue, working across strategy, copy, lifecycle email and analytics.

seo.title: {name} — {title}
seo.description: {name}, {title}. Campaign results, writing samples and how to work together.
seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: the approach, the campaigns and content behind the results, and the teams worked with.

summary.hint: What you owned and the result it produced.

highlights.label: Key results
highlights.hint: One per line, up to 12. Lead with the figure where you have one.

title.hint: Name the campaign or the piece, for example the product launch or the article series.

role.hint: Your part, for example Campaign lead or Writer and editor.

org.label: Client or brand
org.hint: Shown on the card and in the client strip on the home page. Only name a client you have permission to name.

problem.label: The brief
problem.hint: The goal and the audience. Plain text.

approach.label: What you did
approach.hint: Strategy, channels, content and testing. Plain text.

impact.label: Results
impact.hint: One result per line, up to 8. Start with the figure, such as "+38% click-through", so it is shown large; the first line is shown on the card. Use figures you can stand behind.

heroImage.label: Cover image
heroImage.hint: Shown on the work grid and at the top of the case study. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a 16:10 card.

screenshots.label: Case-study images
screenshots.hint: Add pictures one at a time on the Images page, such as a layout, an ad or a chart. Each needs a description for people who cannot see it.

links.label: Links
links.hint: Where to see the live piece, a campaign page or a report. Videos are linked, never embedded.

category.hint: A channel or type such as Email, Social or Long-form writing. Used by the filter on the work page.

credentialUrl.label: Link to the award or course

url.label: Link to the recording or slides
url.hint: http or https. Recordings are linked, not embedded.

quote.label: What they said
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the person's permission.

body.label: Post text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Shown at the top of the post and when it is shared.

heading.label: Home page introduction
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read, above your headline figures. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your specialism and the kind of work you do. Plain text.

heading.label: Headline figures
heading.hint: The big numbers at the top of your home page, such as campaign results, reach or years of experience. Only publish figures you can stand behind. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes it. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Your story, how you work and what you care about. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Principles
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you work, shown above the text.

heading.label: Back up and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

layout.footerNote: Marketing and content portfolio. Results are shared with permission.
